description: This Java source file defines the AndroidProguardOptionsConverterProvider class, which provides functionality for converting Android ProGuard options to a new format within an IDE or build system. It includes nested classes for handling project, module, and artifact conversions related to ProGuard configuration.

classes.name: AndroidProguardOptionsConverterProvider
classes.description: Main class providing conversion of Android ProGuard options, with nested classes for project, module, and artifact conversions.

classes.name: MyProjectConverter
classes.description: Handles creation of module and artifact converters for the project.

classes.name: MyModuleFileConverter
classes.description: Converts module settings related to ProGuard configuration, modifying the configuration XML elements.

classes.name: MyArtifactsConverter
classes.description: Converts artifact settings related to ProGuard, updating configuration elements accordingly.

methods.name: getConversionDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the conversion process.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates and returns a project converter instance.

methods.name: canDetermineIfConversionAlreadyPerformedByProjectFiles
methods.description: Indicates whether the conversion can determine if it has already been performed.

methods.name: isConversionNeeded
methods.description: Checks if conversion is needed for module or artifact settings.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs the conversion process on module or artifact settings.

methods.name: doConvertArtifact
methods.description: Converts artifact configuration elements related to ProGuard.
